review_method: Sequential source-first semantic review across the exact 29 dimensions. Null tiṇai, poet and speaker metadata remain reviewed-empty and are not reconstructed from conventional anthology divisions.

literary_domain.note: Aiṅkuṟunūṟu is treated as Akam work context; this is not inferred from the poem body.

tinai.note: The canonical record has no printed tiṇai value; the mechanical hundred-poem block is not a classifier.

speaker.note: The canonical record has no printed speaker value; none is reconstructed.

poet.note: The canonical record has no printed poet attribution.

flora.note: Exact நெல் and காஞ்சி plant wording retained without modern botanical identification.

fauna.note: Exact சிறுமீன் aquatic wording retained without zoological modernization.

people_social_roles.note: Exact ஊரன் and பாணன் role wording retained without historical identity reconstruction.

occupations_production.note: Exact பாணன் occupational/performance-role wording retained conservatively.

food_subsistence.note: Paddy and fish wording retained as food/subsistence evidence without quantified inference.

settlements_built_environment.note: Exact ஊரன் settlement-linked wording retained without modern place identification.

economy.note: Exact பொன் and abundance wish retained without quantified economic inference.

polity_political_life.note: ஆதன் and அவினி occur in an acclamatory formula; no ruler or polity identity is externally assigned.

arts_music_performance.note: Exact பாணன் performance-role language; no specific performance event is reconstructed.

values_ethical_concepts.note: வாழி / வாழ்க blessing and flourishing language retained as source evaluation.

named_entities.note: ஆதன் and அவினி remain unresolved source forms.
